pages.title: Geodesy
pages.text: $(thing)Geodesy$()$(br2)Measure one baseline and two angles and every other distance follows - that is how countries were mapped, triangle by triangle. Geodesy measures the planet itself. Unlocks the Theodolite Lens, the Geoid Model and the Geodetic Surveyor.

$(thing)Insight$(): 10$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Cartography, Number Systems.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Surveyors measure one side c of a triangle and the angles at both its ends; the third angle γ follows. Write the length a of the side opposite the angle α.
